description: Append-only history: memberships added/removed, tier changes, categories created/activated/archived, apps discovered/missing. Newest first (by time, then id); page with cursor. To poll for new events use after_id instead: events whose seq is greater than after_id, oldest first by seq, each with its seq, and next_after_id (the last seq) to send next time (start at 0); seq is the order events became public, so it never misses an event written late or shown after review, which since can (not with since, cursor or summary). since is exact for events: only changes after that instant. summary=true answers 'what moved this week' in one call instead: per category, apps added/removed/contested, each app's net tier move (up, down, entered or left the top 40) with the S/A moves and membership changes as highlights (each with its reason: why it moved, e.g. under review or checked), plus catalog events; window from since rounded down to its UTC day (default 7 days back, at most the last 31 days), counted over every event in it. By default the 15 busiest categories (lists_total says how many changed); pass list for one.

after_id.description: polling: events whose seq is greater than this, oldest first by seq; send next_after_id from the previous answer, 0 to start (not with since, cursor or summary)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page (not with summary)

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Events: only changes after this exact instant. summary: rounded down to its UTC day, within the last 31 days

summary.description: true: a per-category digest of the window instead of raw events

name: recent_changes
title: What changed
